question.text: Cut-off time for purchase transactions in equity and non-liquid debt schemes is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the NISM Series II-B workbook (pp.141-142), the cut-off time for purchase applications and switch-ins in equity-oriented and non-liquid debt mutual fund schemes is 3:00 PM on a business day. However, for these schemes the applicable NAV is the closing NAV of the day on which funds are available for utilisation, irrespective of the time of receipt of the application. The Trap: 1:30 PM is the cut-off for liquid/overnight fund purchases, not equity/non-liquid debt. Also note that meeting the 3:00 PM cut-off alone does NOT guarantee same-day NAV — for equity/debt purchases, NAV depends on the day funds are actually available for utilisation by the AMC. Note: Always ensure client applications reach the ISC/OPA before 3:00 PM AND use a payment mode (such as RTGS) that makes funds available the same day. Late funds availability can push the applicable NAV to a later business day.
